items.title: Ed Shaughnessy Part I interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 1, 1995 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I would turn on all the remotes of Woody Herman... and I would play the drums with these great bands... what more inspiration could you have then Basie or Woody Herman

ctx.x: Well it’s a late 30’s like ‘39 or ‘40, but it’s terrific because it’s a jazz band movie with a couple of the ex dead end kids playing roles, and oh that movie turned my life around. I thought, that’s what I want to be. I want to be one of those jazz guys on the road. Even though they had a terrible life. But it was glamorous, you know? When they were hot they were hot. The music, and the lead character was a drummer too. So anyway, these are strange ways to take up your life’s instrument I know but it’s the truth…
And three years later you were out?
